admin/admin-overview.title: Admin Overview
admin/admin-overview.description: The Admin Panel is for platform administrators — users with the platform_admin user type. It provides cross-account visibility, account management, billing configuration, and platform-level settings.

admin/managing-accounts.title: Managing Accounts
admin/managing-accounts.description: The Accounts section of the Admin Panel is the starting point for all per-account operations: creating accounts, viewing usage, configuring billing, managing feature flags, and exporting data.

admin/managing-users.title: Managing Users
admin/managing-users.description: The Users section in the Admin Panel provides a platform-wide view of all registered users, regardless of which account they belong to.

admin/platform-billing.title: Platform Billing
admin/platform-billing.description: The Platform Billing section gives platform administrators a cross-account view of usage, margin analysis, and the controls to configure billing rates for all accounts.

admin/platform-settings.title: Platform Settings
admin/platform-settings.description: Platform Settings control system-wide configuration: SMTP for alert emails, default feature entitlements, and diagnostic tools.

admin/security-log.title: Security Log
admin/security-log.description: The Security Log is an append-only record of security-relevant events across the platform. Platform administrators use it to detect suspicious activity, investigate incidents, and verify compliance.

analytics/call-analytics.title: Call Analytics
analytics/call-analytics.description: The Call Analytics dashboard provides an aggregated view of your call volume, AI performance, resolution rates, and costs over any time period.

analytics/call-logs.title: Call Logs
analytics/call-logs.description: The Call Logs table is the complete, paginated record of every call handled by the platform. Each row links to a full call detail view with transcript, events, ACW, and billing data.

analytics/sms-analytics.title: SMS Analytics
analytics/sms-analytics.description: The SMS Analytics dashboard shows message volume, conversation trends, and cost data for your SMS channel.

assistants/acw-and-qa.title: After-Call Work & QA
assistants/acw-and-qa.description: After-Call Work (ACW) is Botelier's automated post-call analysis system. After each call ends, the platform sends the full transcript to an LLM and returns a structured QA summary including scores, disposition, and resolution status.

assistants/creating-an-assistant.title: Creating an Assistant
assistants/creating-an-assistant.description: An Assistant is the core entity in Botelier — it encapsulates everything the AI agent needs to handle a call or SMS conversation: speech providers, the language model, a knowledge base, tools, and conversation flow.

assistants/greeting-cache.title: Greeting Cache
assistants/greeting-cache.description: The Greeting Cache pre-generates the assistant's opening audio so it can be delivered to callers in under 100 ms — before the TTS provider has even received the request.

flows/flow-editor-overview.title: Flow Editor Overview
flows/flow-editor-overview.description: The Visual Flow Editor is a drag-and-drop canvas for building structured conversation scripts. Instead of relying solely on a system prompt to guide the AI, flows let you define explicit paths, collect structured data from callers, and branch based on their responses.

flows/flow-simulation.title: Flow Simulation
flows/flow-simulation.description: The Flow Simulator and API Tester let you test your flow logic before routing any live calls through it.

flows/flow-versioning.title: Flow Versioning
flows/flow-versioning.description: Botelier creates a new version every time you save a flow. Versions let you track changes, roll back to a previous state, and promote a past version to active.

flows/node-reference.title: Node Reference
flows/node-reference.description: Complete reference for every node type in the Botelier Flow Editor.

getting-started/platform-overview.title: Platform Overview
getting-started/platform-overview.description: Botelier is a multi-tenant, multichannel AI platform that lets businesses deploy configurable AI agents to handle voice calls and SMS conversations — with web chat on the near-term roadmap.

getting-started/quick-start.title: Quick Start
getting-started/quick-start.description: This guide walks you from first login to your first AI-handled call.

integrations/custom-api-via-flow.title: Custom API via Flow
integrations/custom-api-via-flow.description: You can call any external API from a Botelier flow without creating a formal integration record. This approach uses Account Secrets to securely store credentials and API Request nodes to make the calls.

integrations/guestcentric-crs.title: GuestCentric CRS
integrations/guestcentric-crs.description: The GuestCentric integration connects Botelier to the GuestCentric Central Reservation System, allowing your AI assistant to check availability, look up reservations, and manage bookings during calls.

integrations/integrations-overview.title: Integrations Overview
integrations/integrations-overview.description: The Integrations framework lets your AI assistant connect to external systems during calls and SMS conversations. It supports pre-built connectors for hotel PMS/CRS systems, a flexible MCP server connection protocol, and direct API calls via flow nodes.

integrations/mcp-server.title: MCP Server
integrations/mcp-server.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open protocol for connecting AI models to external data sources and tools. Botelier supports MCP via SSE (Server-Sent Events) transport, allowing you to connect any MCP-compatible server and expose its tools to your AI assistants.

integrations/oracle-opera-ohip.title: Oracle Opera Cloud (OHIP)
integrations/oracle-opera-ohip.description: The Oracle Opera Cloud (OHIP) integration connects Botelier to your Oracle Hospitality property management system via the Opera Cloud REST API.

knowledge-bases/managing-knowledge-bases.title: Managing Knowledge Bases
knowledge-bases/managing-knowledge-bases.description: A Knowledge Base is a collection of question-and-answer entries that the assistant uses to respond to caller questions. During a call, the assistant performs a semantic search over the KB and includes relevant entries in its context window.

phone-numbers/provisioning-numbers.title: Provisioning Phone Numbers
phone-numbers/provisioning-numbers.description: Phone numbers are provisioned from Twilio and assigned to assistants. Each number has Twilio webhook URLs configured automatically by Botelier.

settings/account-settings.title: Account Settings
settings/account-settings.description: Account Settings let you configure your organization's name, timezone, notification preferences, and Twilio sub-account details.

sms-compliance/a2p-10dlc-overview.title: A2P 10DLC Overview
sms-compliance/a2p-10dlc-overview.description: A2P 10DLC (Application-to-Person 10-Digit Long Code) is a US carrier framework that regulates business SMS sent from standard 10-digit phone numbers. It is required for any business sending SMS at scale in the United States.

sms-compliance/brand-registration.title: Brand Registration
sms-compliance/brand-registration.description: A Brand represents your legal business entity in the A2P 10DLC system. You must register a brand before creating any campaigns.

sms-compliance/campaign-registration.title: Campaign Registration
sms-compliance/campaign-registration.description: A Campaign declares a specific messaging use case and links your brand to the phone numbers used for that use case. You need at least one approved campaign before sending business SMS.

sms-compliance/compliance-checklist.title: Compliance Checklist
sms-compliance/compliance-checklist.description: Use this checklist before sending any business SMS from US local numbers.

sms/human-takeover.title: Human Takeover
sms/human-takeover.description: Human Takeover lets a human agent take control of an AI-managed SMS conversation, reply directly to the customer, and optionally hand the conversation back to the AI.

sms/messaging-inbox.title: Messaging Inbox
sms/messaging-inbox.description: The Messaging Inbox is the unified view for all SMS conversations across your account. Agents use it to monitor AI-handled threads, take over conversations when needed, and send manual replies.

sms/sms-ai-config.title: SMS AI Configuration
sms/sms-ai-config.description: Each assistant can be enabled for SMS in addition to (or instead of) voice calls. The SMS AI responds to inbound messages using the same LLM, knowledge base, and tools as the voice assistant.

sms/sms-templates.title: SMS Templates
sms/sms-templates.description: SMS Templates are reusable message snippets that agents can insert into the reply box with a single click. They save time for common responses and ensure consistent messaging.

team/api-keys.title: API Keys
team/api-keys.description: API Keys allow programmatic access to Botelier's REST API on behalf of your account. Use them when integrating Botelier with external systems, CI/CD pipelines, or custom dashboards.

team/permissions-reference.title: Permissions Reference
team/permissions-reference.description: This page lists every named permission in Botelier and which default role grants it.

team/team-management.title: Team Management
team/team-management.description: The Team section lets account administrators invite users, assign roles, and revoke access.

tools/tools-overview.title: Tools Overview
tools/tools-overview.description: Tools are actions the AI assistant can take during a conversation. When the LLM decides that an action is needed (e.g. "transfer this caller to billing"), it invokes the appropriate tool by name.

usage-billing/billing-alerts.title: Billing Alerts
usage-billing/billing-alerts.description: Billing Alerts notify platform admins and the account owner when an account's month-to-date (MTD) spend crosses a configured threshold.

usage-billing/usage-summary.title: Usage Summary
usage-billing/usage-summary.description: The Usage page provides a real-time view of your account's call and SMS costs for the current period, including a paginated per-call cost list and a cost timeseries chart.
